CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_entrega_confirmar_v1(p_entrega_id uuid, p_recebedor jsonb, p_opcoes jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN public.fn_entrega_confirmar_engine_v1(p_entrega_id, NULL, NULL, p_recebedor, p_opcoes);
END;
$function$
